name: Giant Teacup Tide Pools
description: A rocky coastline where enormous porcelain teacups form tide pools filled with colorful sea life.
prompt: A single whimsical coastal scene where enormous antique porcelain teacups are embedded in rocks and filled with crystal-clear tide pool water. Tiny starfish, anemones, and clownfish live inside the cups, with delicate floral patterns on the porcelain. Sunset light, gentle waves, seafoam, playful surrealism, highly detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: High tide, low tide, or tea time? These giant teacup tide pools make every wave feel cozy.
